data.name: Island Yoga
data.headline: Complimentary for Resort Guests | Fridays & Saturdays | 10am
data.description:
**Start your morning off right!**

Find serenity at Paradise and join our island yoga class. Aside from relaxing and managing stress, yoga also helps you increase flexibility, build muscle strength, improve your sleep and bring balance to your day. The class is open to all abilities.
________
data.highlights:
**About Your Paradise Yoga Experience**

Start your day with a peaceful waterfront yoga session overlooking San Diego's Mission Bay. Breathe in the fresh sea air, soak up the Southern California sunshine, and let the gentle sounds of the bay create the perfect setting for relaxation and renewal.

Designed for all experience levels, this outdoor class offers an opportunity to improve flexibility, build strength, reduce stress, and reconnect with both mind and body—all while enjoying one of Paradise Point's most scenic locations..
_______________

data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or credit. If we need to cancel your reservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will also receive a full refund or credit.

**To cancel or inquire about your reservation, please contact us by phone 619-247-9345**. No-shows and cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged in full.
data.booking_notes:
You're all set. Head over to the Paradise Terrace at the scheduled date/time to join the class. Personal yoga mats are encouraged, however they are included.

Please arrive 15 minutes prior to sign the waiver and to settle into your spot.
